description: A small city park in spring, with pink blossom trees and blocks of flats behind. A young woman in a lilac jacket hurries past, clutching her tiny dog to her chest and staring back with a worried face, and leaves the view. Behind her a large black and tan rottweiler lies calmly on the grass with a small grey kitten standing on its head, while a smiling young woman in a yellow hoodie crouches beside it and strokes it. A man in a navy T-shirt holds a small terrier on a lead.
